title: Stone Stack
instructions: Stack three small objects (stones, blocks) into a stable tower within 20 seconds.

title: Root Relay
instructions: Pass a small token around the group using only elbows; complete two full rotations.

title: Echo Cave
instructions: One player whispers a phrase; it must be correctly repeated by the last player after being whispered around the circle.

title: Moss Maze
instructions: Guide a blindfolded player through a short path using only single-word directions.

title: Tremor Balance
instructions: All players stand on one leg for 30 seconds while holding hands; no one may touch the ground with the other foot.

title: Mountain Song
instructions: Compose and sing a short chant together where each player adds a line that rhymes with the previous.
